issue: सूर श्याम शरण आए — Drik Panchang prints 'सूर' श्याम, marking सूर as the poet's name; the book joins it into one name (सूरश्याम). The refuge is Gaṇeśa's (the same line asks him सफल कीजे सेवा).
our reading: Sūraśyāma (the poet's name) has come to your refuge.
alternatives: The poet Sūra (Sūradāsa, whose signature is often सूर स्याम) has come to your refuge.
